activated: {M}: Return all cards exiled with ~ to their owner's hand and you lose that much life.

activated: {M}: Return this card from your graveyard or from exile to the battlefield tapped.
activated: {M}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only during your upkeep and only if N or more creature cards are above this card.
activated: {M}, Return this creature to its owner's hand: Add {M}. Activate only as a sorcery.
activated: {M}: Reveal target face-down permanent. If it's a creature card, you may turn it face up.
activated: {M}, Roll a dN: Monstrosity X, where X is the result.
activated: {M}, Sacrifice ~: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put ~'s counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to ~ to that creature.

activated: {M}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exchange control of target artifact, creature, or land you control and target permanent an opponent controls that shares N of those types with it. If those permanents are exchanged this way, destroy all Auras attached to them.
activated: {M}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target activated ability from an artifact source and destroy that artifact if it's on the battlefield.
activated: {M}, Sacrifice this creature: Each player shuffles the cards from their hand into their library, then draws that many cards.
activated: {M}, Sacrifice this creature: The next spell you cast this turn can't be countered.
activated: {M}, Sacrifice this creature: Turn all cards exiled with this creature face up. Counter all spells with those names.
activated: {M}: Search your library for a Dragon permanent card and put it into your graveyard. If you do, ~ becomes a copy of that card until end of turn. Then shuffle.

activated: {M}, {T}: Add N mana of any color in your commander's color identity. If you spend this mana to cast your commander, it enters with a number of additional +N/+N counters on it equal to the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.
activated: {M}, {T}: Add N mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast your commander, scry X, where X is the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.
activated: {M}: Target creature gets +N/+N until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to activate this ability, that creature also gains deathtouch until end of turn.
activated: {M}: Target creature you don't control blocks target creature you control with a power and toughness sticker on it other than ~ this turn if able.
activated: {M}: Target player other than this artifact's owner gains control of it. Activate only during your turn.
activated: {M}, {T}: Change the target of target spell with a single target if that target is you. The new target must be a player. X is twice the mana value of that spell.
activated: {M}, {T}: Choose N — | • Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. Spend only white mana on X. | • You gain X life. Spend only white mana on X.

activated: {M}, {T}: Choose target enchantment you control that doesn't have the same name as another permanent you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary. If the token is an Aura, untap ~, then scry N. Activate only as a sorcery.
activated: {M}, {T}: Copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. X is the mana value of the exiled card.
activated: {M}, {T}: Create a N/N creature token of the chosen color and type.

activated: {M}, {T}: Create a N/N red Phyrexian Goblin creature token. Activate only if an oil counter was removed from a permanent you controlled this turn or a permanent with an oil counter on it was put into a graveyard this turn.
activated: {M}, {T}: Create an X/X black Phyrexian Minion creature token, where X is the life paid as this artifact entered.
activated: {M}, {T}: Create an X/X creature token of the chosen color and type, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.
activated: {M}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of a card you exiled with cards named ~. X is the mana value of that card.

activated: {M}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it's a N/N red Balloon creature in addition to its other colors and types and it has flying and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.
activated: {M}, {T}, Discard a card: Until end of turn, if you tap a land for mana, it produces N mana of a color of your choice instead of any other type and amount.
activated: {M}, {T}, Discard the last card you drew this turn: Draw a card.
activated: {M}, {T}: Double the amount of each type of unspent mana you have.
activated: {M}, {T}: Draw a card for each color among permanents you control.
activated: {M}, {T}: Draw a card for each creature type noted for target permanent you control named ~'s Journal.
activated: {M}, {T}: Draw a card. For each mana in this ability's activation cost, you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay that mana. Activate only as a sorcery.

activated: {M}, {T}: Draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. This artifact's owner draws a card, then that player may put a land card from their hand onto the battlefield.
activated: {M}, {T}: Draw a card. The player to your right gains control of this artifact.
activated: {M}, {T}: Draw N cards. Spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability.
activated: {M}, {T}: Each nontoken permanent with a name originally printed in the Antiquities expansion is sacrificed by its controller.
activated: {M}, {T}: Empower Jace N.

activated: {M}, {T}, Exile a spell you control: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a card with mana value equal to N plus the exiled spell's mana value. Exile that card, then that player shuffles. You may cast that exiled card without paying its mana cost.
activated: {M}, {T}, Exile N cards from your graveyard: Add {M}. When you spend this mana to cast a spell or activate an ability, copy that spell or ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

activated: {M}, {T}, Exile N or more other artifacts you control with total mana value X: Return target artifact card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
activated: {M}, {T}: Exile N target cards from a single graveyard. Draw a card.

activated: {M}, {T}: Exile target creature and all Auras attached to it. Note the number and kind of counters that were on that creature. When this artifact leaves the battlefield or becomes untapped, return that exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control tapped with the noted number and kind of counters on it. If you do, return the other exiled cards to the battlefield under their owner's control attached to that permanent.

activated: {M}, {T}: Exile target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from your graveyard and choose an Attraction you control that doesn't have a midway counter on it. Put a midway counter on it. For as long as that Attraction is on the battlefield, whenever you visit it, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

activated: {M}, {T}: Exile target nonlegendary creature you control. Shards you control become copies of it until the next end step. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

activated: {M}, {T}: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, destroy target creature an opponent controls. If you lose the flip, destroy target creature you control unless you pay {M} and repeat this process.
activated: {M}, {T}: For each planeswalker you control, you may activate N of its loyalty abilities once this turn as though none of its loyalty abilities have been activated this turn.
activated: {M}, {T}: For N spell this turn, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any type to pay that spell's mana cost.
activated: {M}: The next N damage that would be dealt to this creature this turn is dealt to its owner instead. Only this creature's owner may activate this ability.
